title: The Lantern Log
solution: SEARCH THE ARCHIVE FOR THE LANTERN LOG. ITS LAST PAGE NAMES THE NORTH PIER. FOLLOW THE BLUE LIGHT.
ciphertext: LTQKEI ZIT QKEIOCT YGK ZIT SQFZTKF SGU. OZL SQLZ HQUT FQDTL ZIT FGKZI HOTK. YGSSGV ZIT WSXT SOUIZ.
briefing: The archivist recognizes the blue lantern mark. She hands you a catalog slip, but its letters no longer follow a simple shift. Find the next destination.
ending: The lantern log names the north pier. Its final sketch shows a boat following a blue light through dark water. You leave the archive for the harbor.
clues: ZIT appears 4 times as a whole word. Repeated words still help even when there is no single alphabet shift.
This is a substitution cipher. Every cipher letter has one fixed meaning, but neighboring letters need not stay neighbors. The message begins SEARCH THE ARCHIVE.
Cipher Z is T, I is H, and T is E. The short word SGU means LOG, and the final two words mean BLUE LIGHT.
